name: php-8.4.26-deb13-apxs2-amd64

config.display_errors: On (vhost php.ini, leak delivered in Set-Cookie)

status: contributor-reported, not independently confirmed — RCE verified on a source-built Debian 13 lab (apxs2, Apache 2.4.69 prefork, 1 worker): uid=33(www-data) 4/4 runs through the vendor engine with this profile's parameters; stages 1-2 dispatch cleanly on every attempt. Stage-3 phase is instance-dependent (after an apache restart, a fresh master may not reclaim; retry on a new instance) and the layout differs from the docker 8.4.26 image (different toolchain): third stage-3 layout with a K=5 bin-32 phase shift. Each (4,4) pad allocates the session reference at the k-th bin-32 slot, shifting the fake-reference slot linearly, R0 = chunk+0x2260+0x60*K (gdb watchpoint sweep 0..16); K=5 places the bin-56 reclaim slot so the 31-byte fake reference is written whole (chars at R0, framing differs from the upstream 55-byte carrier whose chars land at R0+8). Stage-3 request 1 carries a PHPSESSID cookie and five 5-char/1-byte fill fields; request 2 reclaims with 15x 167-byte fake hashtables then 12x 31-byte fake references, all with 3-char field names. Command proof read out-of-band from /tmp inside the apache mount namespace (PrivateTmp; nsenter).
